name: DynamicMusicBG
tagline: 根据当前音乐封面，在锁屏正在播放控件后方生成流动的动态色彩背景。
description: 动态音乐锁屏背景会从当前音乐封面提取代表色，并在锁屏正在播放控件后方呈现平滑流动的色彩背景。
切换歌曲时颜色自然过渡；暂停播放、开启减弱动态效果或屏幕进入暗显状态时，动画会自动暂停。
features: 根据当前音乐封面自动生成动态色彩背景
经典流动、氛围流动和轻柔流动三种动画效果
切换歌曲时平滑过渡至新封面配色
播放暂停、减弱动态效果及屏幕暗显时自动暂停动画
可与空间场景和趣味壁纸同时使用
设置修改立即生效，并支持 English、简体中文和繁體中文
usage: 安装后打开“设置”中的动态音乐锁屏背景并启用插件。
选择经典流动、氛围流动或轻柔流动效果。
播放带有有效封面的音乐并进入锁屏；正在播放控件出现时，动态背景会自动显示。

changes: 新增根据音乐封面生成锁屏动态色彩背景，并提供三种动画效果。
新增切歌配色平滑过渡，以及播放暂停、减弱动态效果和屏幕暗显联动。
增强与空间场景、趣味壁纸同时使用时的显示兼容性。

en.name: DynamicMusicBG
en.tagline: Create a flowing album-art-driven color background behind Lock Screen Now Playing.
description: DynamicMusicBG extracts representative colors from the current album artwork and presents a smoothly animated background behind Lock Screen Now Playing.
Colors transition naturally when tracks change, while motion pauses automatically when playback pauses, Reduce Motion is enabled, or the display enters its dim state.
features: Generate an animated color background from the current album artwork
Legacy, Ambient, and Subtle animation styles
Smooth palette transitions when tracks change
Pause motion automatically with playback, Reduce Motion, and display dimming
Coexist with SpatialScene and Lenticular Wallpaper
Apply Settings changes immediately with English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese support
usage: Open DynamicMusicBG in Settings after installation and enable the tweak.
Choose the Legacy, Ambient, or Subtle animation style.
Play music with valid artwork and open the Lock Screen; the animated background appears automatically with Now Playing.

changes: Added album-art-driven animated Lock Screen colors with three animation styles.
Added smooth track-change transitions and motion control for playback, Reduce Motion, and display dimming.
Improved display compatibility when used with SpatialScene and Lenticular Wallpaper.
